response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C/C++ and distributed systems, but primarily in Node.js, D, and TypeScript. His background lacks direct experience with modern C++ for geospatial/navigation pipelines, and his recent roles have focused on web/mobile applications rather than high-performance routing data processing. His open-source GISCollective project shows geospatial interest but not at the scale or complexity required for this role.
strengths: Strong background in software engineering with diverse language experience (C++, D, JavaScript/TypeScript)
Experience with distributed systems, low-latency applications, and geospatial data (GISCollective)
Proven track record of optimizing systems and building scalable solutions
concerns: Limited direct experience with modern C++ for routing/navigation systems
Recent work heavily focused on web/mobile rather than high-performance geospatial pipelines
No demonstrated experience with Rust, which is listed as an acceptable alternative to C++

key_factors.factor: C++ and Rust experience for routing systems
